sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Assign add control before pulling the bridgekeeper.
Lirah repeatedly draws idle protectors into combat and checks for replacements.
Keep the boss tank stable while controlling renewed protectors.
A disengagement clears and rebuilds the supporting formation.
